budget_barrier.rule: at launch and at every checkpoint: spent + projected remaining (planned items not completed; the running item's remaining replicates at the larger of planned and observed per-replicate CPU; overhead less overhead spent) must be <= the ceiling, else the run stops before further work, writes no report and waits for a dated prospective repricing; counts, draws and qualification work never change

disposition.future_boundary: (d) *Future boundary, binding from now.* Every F12 or F12-I job is limited to 4 GB peak RSS. A heavy input build may exceed that only under a dated chair ruling in this document, committed before launch. The ruling names the build, a peak cap and the thread count. The build must be the only heavy job the programme runs. It may launch only if free memory is at least its cap plus 4 GB. Its peak RSS is recorded in its manifest, and the build is stopped if its peak exceeds its cap. Delegate briefs may not grant memory allowances on their own.
